1.consolidated_definition: alim. Hojuelas de maíz. Alimento elaborado con maíz tostado enriquecido con vitaminas; el término, que se ha extendido a otros cereales, responde a una marca comercial. Anglicismo crudo, usual. O quizas menos relevante, del rumor de que ahora en Fortaleza se ha sustituido el caviar y el champan por junk food, hamburgers, hot dogs, pizzas, bacalaitos, emparedados, cornflakes, fritos y cheetos (El Nuevo Día, 17-02-93)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Cornflakes: Corn flakes made from toasted corn enriched with vitamins; the term, which has been extended to other grains, responds to a commercial brand. Anglicism in its raw form, commonly used. Or perhaps less relevant, referring to the rumor that junk food, hamburgers, hot dogs, pizzas, bacalaitos, sandwiches, fritos, and Cheetos have replaced caviar and champagne in Fortaleza (El Nuevo Día, 17-02-93).
